critical_code_review_comments: google_import.py: oauth/start validates origin_url only startsWith https:// or http://localhost — acceptable for current flow, but no CSRF cookie binding beyond state nonce in Mongo (state expires in 10 min; find_one_and_delete prevents reuse — good).

google_import.py run_api_job: usage/quota check runs per-item (good) but token refresh happens once at job start; for a very long job the access_token could expire mid-run. Consider refreshing on 401. Non-blocking for small batches.
emailer.py _assert_safe_email is strong — forbids forms, non-https links, shorteners, credential-asking text. invite_email uses only https links from APP_URL — safe.
family.py invite: calls send_email in-request path which can add latency up to 30s timeout; consider BackgroundTasks for faster UX on invite button. Currently acceptable (<1s typical).

Family.jsx auto-accept uses setParams({}, {replace: true}) before awaiting the request — if the request errors or user refreshes mid-flight the join id is already gone from URL, so a reload would not retry. Minor UX nit, not blocking.
Login.jsx nextPath rejects '//' prefix correctly (confirmed with //evil.com — stays on /home). Good.
